ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because your query is a math problem, and the deciding factor is raw reasoning capability. Dunlin clearly outperforms Lapwing on the benchmarks most predictive of math accuracy (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA Diamond 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) — gaps well beyond run-to-run variance. The task-preference notes for both models only concern harm-adjacent/distasteful content, which is irrelevant to a benign algebra question, so they didn't factor in. Capability alone pointed to Dunlin.
